result.instruction: Replace the monolithic counter update with registered low and high 4-bit counters: reset both to zero, increment the low nibble each active cycle, and increment the high nibble when the old low nibble is `4'hF`, allowing both nibbles to wrap naturally. Drive the existing registered PWM comparison from the concatenated nibbles and preserve its reset priority and use of the pre-update count. This differs from iteration 1’s monolithic 8-bit counter; retain the candidate only if unchanged deterministic gates pass, routed setup and hold slack are nonnegative, and routed LUT use is strictly below 7.
